dialogues.speaker: Maintenance Log (I)
dialogues.text: "Log: Switch is working properly. However, there are too many loopholes in existing patrols, and the weapons lack power. Considering that there have been several recent attacks, a security level increase is recommended."

dialogues.speaker: Maintenance Log (I)
dialogues.text: "Reply: Acknowledged.\nApproving Party's Suggestion: Merely drive the intruders away. No need to harm anyone."

dialogues.speaker: Maintenance Log (I)
dialogues.text: (The rest of the content seems to be nothing more than ordinary maintenance records...)
